Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! Joylord Gumbie and Tadiwanashe Marumani are the openers.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

For Zimbabwe, Blessing Muzarabani was brilliant and Jongwe also did a decent job. However, the likes of Akram and Raza really went for a few. Those spells can really cost Bangladesh. They're now chasing a big total and will really have to bat well. Bangladesh on the other hand will back themselves to defend this. Join us for the chase in a bit.

More than 100 runs in the last 10 and Bangladesh will feel they're on top in this game at the moment! They were trouble after the first 10. Raza and Blessing Muzarabani were excellent as they did not let the hosts score freely and also got three wickets. However, Towhid Hridoy and Ali batted really well. They added well over 50 and took Bangladesh to safer shores. Hridoy scored a fine fifty but fell towards the end. Mahmudullah added the finishing touch and took his side over the 160-run mark.
A dot to end but the damage was done earlier. Full and outside off. Hossain swings but misses. BANGLADESH END WITH 165!

TOSS - ZIMBABWE HAVE WON THE TOSS AND ELECTED TO BOWL!

It is time for the third T20I between Bangladesh and Zimbabwe. It has been one way traffic so far in the series with Bangladesh winning 2 in 2. Another win will see them seal the series with two games to go. Zimbabwe have showed some fight in both the games but they need to perform a lot better in pressure situations. Especially the senior players in the side, it is time for them to step up in this important game. It is a must-win for them if they are to stay alive in the series. Stay tuned for the toss and teams.
... MATCH DAY ...

Time for match number 3 of this 5-match T20I series between Bangladesh and Zimbabwe. The hosts lead this series 2 games to nil and the visitors have failed to even put up a fight of any sort in the first couple of games. The Batting unit of Zimbabwe have failed miserably and the hosts have made full use of it. Brian Bennett has been the brightest prospect for Zimbabwe with the bat and there were glimpses of a solid batter in Johnathan Campbell in the second game as well. Joylord Gumbie, Tadiwanashe Marumani, Craig Ervine and Sikandar Raza have not managed to perform with the bat and need to step up if they are to stay alive in the series. The bowlers have done decent for them so far. Bangladesh on the other hand have been spot-on in executing their plans. The bowlers have bowled well and the batters have backed it up. The side is not lacking match-winners and everybody has chipped in with a contribution to the team's winning cause. The side would be looking to seal the series in the third game itself.  Can Zimbabwe bounce back and keep the series alive or will Bangladesh carry on the winning momentum and clinch the series? We shall find out when these sides collide.
